name: Single-object marginal metric impact
definition: Baseline scalar static metric minus its value after individually deleting each node or edge; optional baseline-relative difference.
source_version: Latora & Marchiori PRE 71,015103 (2005), arXiv 0407491 (2004), vulnerability idea; explicit generalized definition here v1.0.0, not a claim all base metrics share their interpretation.
license: Original formula implementation; no third-party source copied.
complexity: O(K*(N+M+C_base)); K=N for nodes or M for edges
validation_status: Analytic node/edge count impact and zero-baseline masks validated in test_io; see validation/validation_report.json for current integration result.
conditions: Explicit scalar static base metric; no recursive impact. Actual scope follows target. Zero baseline invalidates relative differences; invalid residual metric invalidates only that object. Each deletion starts from the same original graph.
